text: My words, though made as simple as I can, may be rather deep for some heads.” “Oh yes, Henery, we quite conceive ye.” “A strange old piece, goodmen—whirled about from here to yonder, as if I were nothing worth. A little warped, too. But I have my depths; ha, and even my great depths! I might close with a certain shepherd, brain to brain. But no—Oh no!” “A strange old piece, ye say!” interposed the maltster, in a querulous voice.
